items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You walked after 1 of your scored meals, which is too few to see how it affects you yet. Walking after dinner is linked to a rise in sugar about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: You didn't have any scored dinners that started at 8 pm or later, which is a good thing. Having dinner late is linked to sugar rising about 9.2 mg/dL more.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 12.8 hours, with 66.7% of nights reaching 13 hours. Adding an overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared to coaching alone.
